answer.book: Single polemical work by Johann Heinrich Hottinger, Apologia disceptationi de Eucharistia Solodori nuper emissae (Zürich, 1663), built as a dedication to the Zurich Senate, an index of sections, fourteen numbered sections (Sectio I to XIV), and a closing note to the reader with errata; Sectio II contains an Articulus I.
